tools.name: find_recipe
tools.description: Find a ready-made automation recipe for a plain-words need, e.g. 'when a typeform is submitted add a row to google sheets and send a slack message'. Returns the best matching recipes (apps chained with →, what it does, the n8n workflow JSON, the blanks to fill and accounts to connect) plus matching

tools.name: plan_automation
tools.description: Turn a plain-words need into steps (one trigger + actions) and pick the concrete tool for each step from 3,000+ app capabilities (n8n nodes, OpenAPI, MCP). Reports a gap when the named app cannot do a step instead of substituting another app. Use before building any integration or workflow.

tools.name: make_n8n_workflow
tools.description: Generate an importable n8n workflow JSON from a plain-words need, with every node wired in order, values said out loud already filled (emails, #channels, trigger events), plus the list of blanks only the person can fill and the credentials to connect. Shape-checked; the person tests it in n8n before

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "make_n8n_workflow" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "bridgecore-mcp.chinlee2200.workers.dev" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_recipe, make_n8n_workflow · Private data: make_n8n_workflow · Public sink: find_recipe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_recipe, make_n8n_workflow · Private data: make_n8n_workflow · Public sink: find_recipe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
